title: Google Cloud Storage (GCS) 4-Role ML & TPU Coordination Specification
description: Separates Google Cloud Storage semantics across streaming datasets, multi-host Orbax/PyTorch checkpoints, persistent XLA compilation caches, and optional GKE/TPU FUSE mounts.

zone.description: Target GCP compute/TPU zone enforced for single-region zero-egress bucket parity (e.g. us-central2-b).

datasets.description: Read-only native gs:// streaming dataset prefixes (TFRecord, ArrayRecord, Grain, Parquet) bypassing POSIX FUSE metadata overhead.

name.description: Logical dataset identifier exported as LIBSCRIPT_DATASET_<NAME>_URI.

checkpoints.description: Multi-host distributed Orbax / PyTorch XLA gs:// checkpoint prefix and retention policy.

uri.description: gs://<bucket>/<prefix> destination for multi-host distributed checkpoints.

retention_days.description: GCS object lifecycle age in days after which superseded checkpoint shards are deleted.

async_save.description: Whether asynchronous Orbax/XLA background checkpointing is enabled.

xla_compilation_cache.description: Persistent XLA HLO/PJRT compilation cache exported to JAX_COMPILATION_CACHE_DIR across all TPU workers and GKE pods.

fuse_mounts.description: Optional POSIX FUSE mounts via gcsfuse (TPU VM) or gke-gcsfuse-csi-driver + Workload Identity (GKE/XPK).

items.description: Single opt-in GCS FUSE mount specification.

bucket.description: GCS bucket name or gs:// URI.

stat_cache_mb.description: gcsfuse metadata stat cache capacity in MiB.

type_cache_mb.description: gcsfuse directory type cache capacity in MiB.

workload_identity_ksa.description: Kubernetes ServiceAccount annotated for GKE Workload Identity GCS CSI access.
